DATAPREP_SYNTHESIZED:
def __dataprep(customers_file, mails_file):
    import lester as ld
    import os
    from transformers import pipeline
    os.environ["TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM"] = "False"
    import warnings

    warnings.simplefilter(action='ignore', category=FutureWarning)

    target_countries = ['UK', 'DE', 'FR']

    sentiment_predictor = pipeline('sentiment-analysis', model='distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english')

    def matches_usecase(text):
        return "complaint" in text or "bank account" in text

    def sanitize(text):
        return text.lower()

    customers_df = ld.read_csv(customers_file, header=None, names=['customer_id', 'customer_email', 'bank', 'country', 'level'], sep=',')
    mails_df = ld.read_csv(mails_file, header=None, names=['mail_id', 'email', 'raw_date', 'mail_subject', 'mail_text'], sep=',')

    # Filter customers based on target countries
    customers_df = customers_df.filter(customers_df['country'].isin(target_countries))

    # Project to create 'is_premium' column
    def determine_is_premium(level):
        return level == 'premium'
    customers_df['is_premium'] = customers_df['level'].apply(determine_is_premium)

    # Join mails with customer data on email
    combined_df = mails_df.merge(customers_df, left_on='email', right_on='customer_email')

    # Filter mails based on year
    def filter_recent_mails(raw_date):
        return int(raw_date.split("-")[0]) >= 2022
    combined_df = combined_df[combined_df['raw_date'].apply(filter_recent_mails)]

    # Create columns 'title', 'text', 'sentiment'
    combined_df['title'] = combined_df['mail_subject'].apply(sanitize)
    combined_df['text'] = combined_df['mail_text'].apply(sanitize)

    def get_sentiment(mail_text):
        return sentiment_predictor(mail_text)[0]['label'].lower()
    combined_df['sentiment'] = combined_df['mail_text'].apply(get_sentiment)

    # Select and rename final columns
    result_df = combined_df[['title', 'text', 'bank', 'country', 'sentiment', 'is_premium']]

    return result_df
